description: SVG Lab's reference, on demand. No arguments: every operation run can call and every design guide, one line each. op: an operation's arguments, output shape and executable examples. ops: up to 25 operations in one reply. recipe: assembly, chunking, recovery, layout-patches or helpers (working scripts with input and output). guide: design and drawing advice. query: keyword search over operations and guides.

guide.description: One guide's id from the index, e.g. typography-direction.

ops.description: Several operation names, returned together in request order.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "gradient" or "draw a hand".

name: docs
title: Read the engine reference
